stem: In 1961, President John F. Kennedy said that the United States should set a goal of landing an American on the moon by 1970. After much hard work and preparation, two Americans landed on the moon in 1969.
instruction:
READ the information in the box below.

THINK carefully about the following statement.

Some people think it is easier to accomplish something if they set a goal in advance.

WRITE an essay explaining why setting a goal is important.
visual_elements: Box containing text: In 1961, President John F. Kennedy said that the United States should set a goal of landing an American on the moon by 1970. After much hard work and preparation, two Americans landed on the moon in 1969.
